notes.title: AI LIMIT Patch Notes STEAM&PS5
notes.content:
[b]※【PC】If you encounter infinite loading or a black screen after updating the game, please try the following steps:

Update to the latest version and verify the integrity of your game files:
 Right-click the game in your Steam Library → Select “Properties” → Go to “Installed Files” → Click “Verify integrity of game files”.

If the issue persists:
 - Go to Steam Settings → “Downloads” → Disable “Shader Pre-Caching”.
 - Right-click the game → “Properties” → Disable Cloud Saves, then restart Steam.
 - If none of the above resolves the issue, try reinstalling the game.[/b]

Thank you to all players for your valuable feedback and bug reports. We will continue to listen to your voices and respond swiftly with improvements.
The current version of the game is generally stable. Some remaining issues—identified but requiring further testing or longer-term solutions—will be addressed in future patches.

The following changes apply to PC ver. 1.0.023 & PS5 ver. 1.000.024

[b]System[/b]
[list]
[*] 【PC】Improved the interaction logic between VSYNC and LOCK FPS settings.
[*] Optimized shop behavior: in NG+ cycles, Moose’s no longer requires re-unlocking to purchase weapon upgrade materials.
[*] Fixed an issue where respawn points could be incorrectly placed in certain situations.
[/list]

[b]Levels and Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted collision and hitbox logic for some bosses to reduce the chance of players being pushed out of the arena.
[*] Fixed camera culling issues in specific areas.
[*] Fixed boundary issues in certain levels.
[*] Fixed a bug where some bosses could unintentionally fall out of their designated combat area.
[/list]

[b]Visuals[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed visual issues related to the protagonist and certain level areas.
[*] Fixed lingering visual effects from some skills that remained in the environment for too long.
[*] 
[/list]

[b]Other Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Corrected display issues for some UI elements and text.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Spell Flame Jet would continue to remain active after entering the next area under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed bugs where certain weapon skills or spells could incorrectly cause the character to remain airborne.
[/list]

notes.title: Announcement on Save Data Corruption
notes.content:
Dear players,

We have noticed reports from some players regarding lost save data. Here are the solutions:

1. If your save data is lost due to cloud save issues, please contact us via Discord, and we will provide a save file matching your progress.

Discord: https://discord.gg/bTBPQPVz7D

2. If your encounter corrupted save data during gameplay, please reach out to us through the same contact method.

3.We strongly recommend avoiding any modifications to game data. We have identified multiple cases where third-party software modifications have led to progression issues and irreversible save corruption.

Thank you for your understanding and support!

tags.bug: We have noticed reports from some players regarding lost save data.

notes.title: AI LIMIT Hotfix Announcement:
notes.content:
We sincerely apologize for the bugs encountered at launch.

If you experience any of the following issues, please exit Steam and update the 6.5GB patch:

·Main menu text not displaying

·Stuck in the Lore Boss fight

·Deluxe Edition reward chest not appearing

If you continue to experience black screen issues, achievements not unlocking, infinite loading, or missing Russian text after updating, please try the following:

·Right-click the game in your Steam library → Select "Properties" → Go to "Installed Files" → Click "Verify integrity of game files"

·Open Steam settings → Go to the "Downloads" section → Disable "Enable Shader Pre-Caching" to improve performance

If the issue persists, please uninstall and reinstall the game.

Additionally, if the "Language Selection" screen at the start does not display Russian, please select another language to enter the game, then switch to Russian in the "Game Settings" menu.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: AI LIMIT Dev Log #2
notes.content:
We would like to extend our heartfelt thanks to all players for their valuable feedback and suggestions. In response to numerous requests and to gather more feedback, the AI LIMIT demo, originally set to end on October 21, will now be available until November 3.

The full version of AI LIMIT will include the following updates:

1. System
1.1 Further optimizations to performance issues, enhancing frame rate and visual fidelity.
1.2 Adaptation for ultra-wide screens such as 21:9 and 32:9.

2. Combat Balance – Main Character
2.1 Improved rolling/dodging mechanics.
2.2 Sync Rate will automatically recover when it drops to Empty Energy.
2.3 Optimized the acquisition and consumption of Sync Rate.
2.3 Reduced recovery time for certain attacks.
2.4 Reduced recovery time after using Life Dew.

3. Combat Balance – Monsters
3.1 Optimized the startup animations for enemy attacks to enhance recognition.
3.2 Improved the Sync Rate consumption mechanics for enemies that utilize Sync Rate.

4. Other Adjustments
4.1 Enhanced the appearance of water surfaces.
4.2 Added voice performances for the main character when taking damage.
4.3 Introduced new idle animations for the main character during long periods of inactivity.
4.4 Optimized the damage reactions for certain monsters.
4.5 Improved camera work for throwing animations.

Some issues that have already been resolved will also be included in the full version after further testing. Additionally, some reported problems are currently unresolvable due to underlying technical framework issues, and we will continue to explore alternative solutions.

Thank you for your ongoing support!

Sincerely,
Publisher: CE-Asia & Developer: Sense Games

notes.title: AI LIMIT Demo Version Update Log #1
notes.content:
We sincerely thank all players for their valuable feedback and suggestions. The Demo version will continue to incorporate feedback from the player community, and adjustments will be made as quickly as possible. 

Below are the changes and fixes applied in Steam Build lD:16068753  / Version 1.0.009

1.System
  1.1 Fixed an issue where the mouse could not be used to allocate points in the "Upgrade" page.
  1.2 Optimized the information panel for the Primary Seal.
  1.3 Improved the camera movement speed when using the mouse.
  1.4 Temporarily turn off VSYNC and Motion Blur by default.

2.Combat Balance – Main Character
  2.1 Increased the damage of all weapons within the Dual weapons module.
  2.2 Reduced the startup time for weapon skill of the Blader Greatsword.
  2.3 Enhanced the Overload Burst damage and sync rate recovery of the Frame ability "Shield".
  2.4 Improved the Poise for the final attack in standard combos for the following weapons: Blader Greatsword, Serrated Halberd, Knight's Lance, and Impact Drill.

3.Combat Balance – Enemies in Stages
  3.1 Reduced HP for certain enemies.
  3.2 Lowered the poise and attack angle correction for all robot types.
  3.3 Decreased the HP and damage of the Lost Blader and Necro Floater.

4.Combat Balance – Boss: Lore, the Lost Lancer
  4.1 Decreased the Boss's HP and damage
  4.2 Shortened the hitbox duration for several attacks and reduced angle corrections.
  4.3 Fixed AI behavior logic issues.
  4.4 Lowered the remaining HP of the Boss after phase transitions.

5.Combat Balance – Challenge Boss: Hunter of Bladers
  5.1 Reduced the Boss's HP, sync rate damage, and the sync rate tier bonus to attack power.
  5.2 Decreased the sync rate recovery ability triggered by headaches.
  5.3 Lowered the frequency of backward flashes.
  5.4 Reduced the damage and angle correction for certain attacks.
  5.5 Shortened the hitbox duration for skills with explosion.

6.Other Details and Fixes
  6.1 Fixed a UI text error.
  6.2 Resolved missing subtitles in the Traditional Chinese and Japanese versions.
  6.3 Adjusted the facial features of the main character and fixed issues with cartoon render outlines.
  6.4 Optimized the item placement sequence in the tutorial area.
  6.5 Fixed a bug where reverse map running triggered hidden respawn points.
  6.6 Resolved scene component disappearance issues caused by occlusion culling.
  6.7 Improved performance in certain areas.
  6.8 Fixed a black screen issue during cutscenes on the PS5 version.

Additionally, based on the feedback received from the Demo, significant adjustments will be made to the balance and values in the official version.Once again, thank you all for your valuable feedback!

notes.title: AI LIMIT Steam Next Fest Demo is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h3][b]AI LIMIT Steam Next Fest Demo is Out Now!
You can hands-on during the Steam Next Fest.[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842199/fb6bb931255d1fca75c8cd7009d8bfc28b6eeedd.jpg[/img]

In the limited time, AI Limit demo, players will experience the entire first level "Sewer Town Southwest", 
which will take approximately two hours to complete. 
The gameplay will include enemy, elite, and boss battles.
There are various weapons and items hidden within the secret paths of the game, 
so be sure to explore carefully.

After finishing the demo, we have also prepared a Boss Challenge Mode. 
In this Mode, players can encounter a fierce boss and get a glimpse of the mid-game combat and equipment combination mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842199/2a708d8c2ce62a52af80c90b435cccfc497fd89b.jpg[/img]

-This demo will be available in four languages:
 English, and Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.
-For the official release, we currently anticipate supporting the following languages: 
Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), and German.


-We recommend playing the game with a controller. 
You can also customize your controls in the menu under 
[Settings] - [Controller Settings] / [Keyboard Settings]. 
Additionally, we welcome your feedback on the keyboard and mouse configuration.


-There are some known optimization issues in the current demo version. 
If you encounter stuttering or severe frame drops, please try restarting the game. 
We are actively working on optimizing these issues, 
and we appreciate your understanding.


-For players with different PC configurations, 
we have recommended graphical settings as follows:

①Minimum System Requirements
Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
Memory: 12 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB

Graphics Settings:
Resolution: 1920x1080
Anti-Aliasing: Off
VSYNC: Off
Motion Blur: Off
LOCK FPS: 30 FPS
Render Quality: Low

②Recommended System Requirements
Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5500
Memory: 16 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT

Graphics Settings:
Resolution: 2560x1440
Anti-Aliasing: On
VSYNC: On
Motion Blur: Off
LOCK FPS: 60 FPS
Render Quality: High

③If you encounter performance issues while playing this demo on a laptop, 
we recommend lowering the resolution and graphical settings to improve your experience.
There are many types of PC configurations, and you can adjust the settings based on your specific situation. 


-If you encounter issues where the game doesn't run properly, please delete the game saves located at the following path and try restarting the game:

C:\Users\(your username)\AppData\LocalLow\SenseGames


-If you encounter bugs or issues, or if you have specific feedback and suggestions about the game, please feel free to contact us through the following channels:
Steam Discussion: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2407270/discussions/0/4690027719979905823/
Discord: https://discord.gg/bTBPQPVz7D


-We will continue to share tips and tricks on our social media platforms,
so please follow our accounts:
